Temple of the Legends (Quest)#000.src: Talk to Kelight at the entrance of the Temple of the Legends, close to {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#000.dst: Sprich mit Kelight am Eingang des Tempels der Legenden nahe {p} bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#001.src: However, as a Legend, I am very busy, autographs and the sort, and that's not to mention my guard duty! To prove you are even worth my time, return when you reach Level {~}.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#001.dst: Doch als Legende bin ich sehr beschäftigt, Autogramme und dergleichen, ganz zu schweigen vom Wachdienst! Beweis, dass du meine Zeit wert bist: Komm wieder, wenn du Stufe {~} erreichst.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#001.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#002.src: I see you want to enter this mighty temple! Do not deny it, I see it in your eyes.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#002.dst: Du willst in diesen mächtigen Tempel! Leugne es nicht, ich seh's in deinen Augen.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#002.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#003.src: It is only natural, after all, to want to join the esteemed ranks of the Legends, such as myself!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#003.dst: Ist ja nur natürlich, sich den erlauchten Reihen der Legenden anschließen zu wollen, so wie ich!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#003.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#004.src: You will need to prove yourself by fighting a powerful beast, hidden deep in this cave beside me.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#004.dst: Du musst dich beweisen, indem du eine mächtige Bestie bekämpfst, die tief in dieser Höhle neben mir haust.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#004.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#005.src: Hm... At a glance, you don't look anything special! Why, you may as well be a common soldier, for all I can imagine!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#005.dst: Hm... Auf den ersten Blick wirkst du gar nicht besonders! Du könntest genauso gut ein einfacher Soldat sein!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#005.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#006.src: Tell me, why should I bother giving you this chance? Because thus far, I'm not impressed.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#006.dst: Sag mir, warum sollte ich dir diese Chance geben? Bisher bin ich nämlich nicht beeindruckt.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#006.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#008.src: You're stubborn? Hah! Don't make me laugh. Do you think you are the first to attempt entry without anything great to show for it?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#008.dst: Du bist stur? Hah! Dass ich nicht lache. Glaubst du, du bist der Erste, der ohne nennenswerte Taten hinein will?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#008.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#009.src: Of course you aren't. Run along, now. Return when you have something truly impressive to show for yourself.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#009.dst: Natürlich nicht. Ab mit dir. Komm wieder, wenn du etwas wirklich Beeindruckendes vorzuweisen hast.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#009.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#010.src: I have a lot of money.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#011.src: ...And? Surely you do not hope to bribe me, do you? What use would I have for whatever meager wealth you have?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#011.dst: ...Und? Du willst mich doch nicht etwa bestechen? Was sollte ich mit deinem kümmerlichen Vermögen?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#011.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#012.src: I'm a Legend! I have everything I could possibly need for the rest of my life! Now, run along. Return when you have something concrete to show me.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#012.dst: Ich bin eine Legende! Ich habe alles, was ich je brauchen könnte! Also, ab mit dir. Komm wieder, wenn du etwas Handfestes vorzuweisen hast.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#012.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#013.dst: Na ja, ich bin schon eine Legende.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#014.src: Ha! You? A Legend?! What a joke. You aren't the first to have tried that, by the way. I know each and every member of our ranks, and you are not one of them.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#014.dst: Ha! Du? Eine Legende?! Was für ein Witz. Du bist übrigens nicht der Erste, der das versucht. Ich kenne jedes Mitglied unserer Reihen, und du bist keins.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#014.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#015.src: Ah, truly, being a gatekeeper of the Temple is an entertaining position. Run along, now. Return when you have something real to show me.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#015.dst: Ah, Torwächter des Tempels zu sein, ist wahrlich unterhaltsam. Ab mit dir. Komm wieder, wenn du etwas Echtes vorzuweisen hast.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#015.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#016.src: If you think I'm not impress
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#016.dst: Wenn du findest, ich bin nicht beeindr

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#017.src: Hmph. Ridiculous. I don't need you to convince me of anything! Clearly, you are nothing but a pretender.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#017.dst: Pah. Lächerlich. Du musst mich von gar nichts überzeugen! Offensichtlich bist du nur ein Hochstapler.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#017.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#018.src: Run along, now. If you don't have anything to show for yourself, don't waste my time!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#018.dst: Ab mit dir. Wenn du nichts vorzuweisen hast, verschwende nicht meine Zeit!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#018.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#021.src: ...But- ah. Since you are still here. Perhaps- no, no, don't be ridiculous, Kelight.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#021.dst: ...Aber- ah. Da du noch hier bist. Vielleicht- nein, nein, sei nicht lächerlich, Kelight.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#021.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#022.src: Come on, Kelight, don't do this, you can't just let them get you with the silent treatment...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#022.dst: Komm schon, Kelight, lass das, du kannst dich nicht von Schweigen weichkochen lassen...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#022.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#023.src: Oh, fine. You've got me interested. What is special about you? You look like a common soldier, and yet...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#023.dst: Na gut. Du hast mein Interesse geweckt. Was ist besonders an dir? Du siehst aus wie ein einfacher Soldat, und doch...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#023.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#024.src: Very well. I will allow you to attempt the trial. Perhaps, then, you will be able to prove yourself.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#024.dst: Nun gut. Ich lasse dich die Prüfung versuchen. Vielleicht kannst du dich dann beweisen.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#024.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#025.src: Hidden deep within a nearby cave is a beast beyond compare. Corrupted, yes, but nothing like the foes you may have faced before.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#025.dst: Tief in einer nahen Höhle haust eine Bestie ohnegleichen. Verderbt, ja, aber nicht wie die Feinde, denen du bisher begegnet bist.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#025.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#026.src: His name is Jorkin, and he knows more about that realm than anyone else I know. Find him near the {p}, in {p}, and request his aid. Tell him I sent you.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#026.dst: Er heißt Jorkin und weiß mehr über jenes Reich als jeder, den ich kenne. Such ihn bei {p} in {p} und bitte ihn um Hilfe. Sag, ich schicke dich.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#026.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#028.src: Find a way to get Kelight to allow you entry into the Temple of the Legends at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#028.dst: Finde einen Weg, damit Kelight dich in den Tempel der Legenden bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] lässt.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#029.src: So you return! Very interesting. That certainly puts you a level beyond any others who have tried... But it is not enough.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#029.dst: Du kommst also zurück! Sehr interessant. Damit stehst du sicher eine Stufe über allen anderen... Aber es reicht nicht.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#029.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#030.src: So? Tell me, why should I bother giving you this chance? Because thus far, I'm not impressed.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#030.dst: Nun? Sag mir, warum sollte ich dir diese Chance geben? Bisher bin ich nämlich nicht beeindruckt.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#030.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#031.dst: Ich bin immer noch sehr stur.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#032.src: So you are! And so am I. You will not get past me that easily, I'm afraid.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#032.dst: Allerdings! Und ich auch. An mir kommst du nicht so leicht vorbei, fürchte ich.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#032.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#033.src: Off you go, then. Don't come back unless you have something to show!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#033.dst: Dann ab mit dir. Komm erst wieder, wenn du etwas vorzuweisen hast!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#033.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#034.src: Yes, I'm starting to get that impression. You are such a headache, you know that?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#034.dst: Ja, den Eindruck bekomme ich langsam. Du bist echt eine Plage, weißt du das?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#034.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#035.src: Fine! Fine. I'll give you a chance. I'm certain you won't succeed, but anything to get you to stop bothering me.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#035.dst: Gut! Gut. Ich gebe dir eine Chance. Du scheiterst sicher, aber Hauptsache, du hörst auf, mich zu nerven.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#035.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#036.src: Ahem. Hidden deep within a nearby cave is a beast beyond compare. Corrupted, yes, but nothing like the foes you may have faced before.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#036.dst: Ähem. Tief in einer nahen Höhle haust eine Bestie ohnegleichen. Verderbt, ja, aber nicht wie die Feinde, denen du bisher begegnet bist.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#036.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#037.src: Talk to Jorkin in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] about Light Dust.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#037.dst: Sprich mit Jorkin in {p} bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] über Light Dust.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#038.src: Ah, hello soldier. What brings you to my humble abode today?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#038.dst: Ah, hallo, Soldat. Was führt dich heute in meine bescheidene Bleibe?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#038.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#039.src: Oh my. You...you want to attack HIM? Th-that horrid beast! Are you mad?!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#039.dst: Oh je. Du...du willst IHN angreifen? D-diese grässliche Bestie! Bist du wahnsinnig?!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#039.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#040.src: Urgh, Kelight keeps sending adventurers like you to their deaths with his asinine tasks!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#040.dst: Urgh, Kelight schickt ständig Abenteurer wie dich mit seinen idiotischen Aufgaben in den Tod!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#040.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#041.src: Fine. If you're really so determined to walk to your death, I can tell you where to go.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#041.dst: Gut. Wenn du so wild entschlossen bist, in den Tod zu gehen, sag ich dir, wohin.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#041.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#042.src: Down in the Roots, there is a cave full of the Light Dust you'll need.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#042.dst: Unten in den Wurzeln gibt es eine Höhle voller Light Dust, das du brauchst.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#042.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#043.src: Powerful corrupteds live in that cave, so be very careful retrieving it, and bring it back to me once you find it.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#043.dst: In der Höhle leben mächtige Verderbte, sei also sehr vorsichtig und bring es mir, sobald du es hast.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#043.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#044.src: Find the lightdust cavern located near the Portal at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#044.dst: Finde die Light-Dust-Höhle nahe dem Portal bei [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#045.src: Retrieve [{~} Light Dust] from the cave at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring it back to Jorkin at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#045.dst: Hol [{~} Light Dust] aus der Höhle bei [{~}, {~}, -{~}] und bring es zu Jorkin bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#046.src: You have the Light Dust, then? Hand it here, I want to see something.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#046.dst: Du hast das Light Dust also? Gib her, ich will etwas prüfen.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#046.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#047.src: Ah, just as I thought. Even this light has been tainted by Corruption. Sorry, looks like you can't fight him, go home.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#047.dst: Ah, wie ich dachte. Selbst dieses Licht ist von der Verderbnis befleckt. Tut mir leid, du kannst ihn nicht bekämpfen, geh heim.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#047.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#048.src: ...urgh, there's no fooling you, is there? You really are committed to trying to fight him.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#048.dst: ...urgh, dich kann man nicht täuschen, was? Du willst wirklich gegen ihn kämpfen.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#048.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#049.src: Well, I wasn't lying when I said the Light Dust was corrupted, but there is a way to purify it.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#049.dst: Nun, ich habe nicht gelogen, als ich sagte, das Light Dust sei verderbt, aber man kann es reinigen.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#049.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#050.src: An old acquaintance of mine, Rayshyroth, has a method. He lives on {p}.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#050.dst: Ein alter Bekannter von mir, Rayshyroth, kennt einen Weg. Er lebt auf {p}.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#050.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#051.src: He knows even more about that...thing, than I do in my years of studying the Nether. Maybe he'll be able to talk you out of this.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#051.dst: Er weiß noch mehr über dieses...Ding als ich nach Jahren der Netherforschung. Vielleicht redet er es dir aus.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#051.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#052.src: Visit Rayshyroth on {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to purify the dust
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#052.dst: Besuche Rayshyroth auf {p} bei [{~}, {~}, -{~}], um den Staub zu reinigen

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#053.src: Oh? Well, greetings. What brings you to our quiet lonely island, let alone all the way up here?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#053.dst: Oh? Nun, sei gegrüßt. Was führt dich auf unsere stille, einsame Insel, noch dazu ganz hier herauf?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#053.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#054.src: Well, I can certainly do it, but I'll need the materials to do so. Shouldn't be anything you can't handle by now, right?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#054.dst: Das kann ich sicher, aber ich brauche die Materialien dafür. Nichts, was du inzwischen nicht schaffst, oder?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#054.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#055.src: You see, below my house here, there is a wellspring from which a powerful magic flux generates.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#055.dst: Siehst du, unter meinem Haus liegt eine Quelle, aus der ein mächtiger magischer Strom entspringt.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#055.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#056.src: It creates a unique magic vapor if disrupted, which I can use to purify the dust for you.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#056.dst: Wird sie gestört, entsteht ein besonderer magischer Dampf, mit dem ich den Staub reinigen kann.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#056.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#057.src: I would say, given how badly corrupted this is, I will need at least [{~} Sky Vapor] for the task.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#057.dst: So verderbt, wie das ist, brauche ich wohl mindestens [{~} Sky Vapor] dafür.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#057.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#058.src: Find the cave on {p} where the Sky Flux gathers at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#058.dst: Finde die Höhle auf {p}, in der sich der Sky Flux sammelt, bei [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#059.src: Give [{~} Sky Vapor] to Rayshyroth at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#060.src: Aha, you're back with the Sky Vapor! Sorry about the climb, even I find it rather inconvenient at times.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#060.dst: Aha, du bist mit dem Sky Vapor zurück! Tut mir leid wegen des Aufstiegs, selbst mir ist er manchmal lästig.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#060.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#061.src: While I perform the ritual to purify this, I'd like to ask you something. Do you know, exactly, what it is you'll be fighting?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#061.dst: Während ich das Reinigungsritual vollziehe, möchte ich dich etwas fragen. Weißt du genau, wogegen du kämpfen wirst?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#061.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#062.src: Don't look so surprised, I know exactly what you need Light Dust for. The corruption warding helmet...to allow you to fight the Corrupter of Worlds.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#062.dst: Schau nicht so überrascht, ich weiß genau, wofür du das Light Dust brauchst. Der Helm gegen Verderbnis...um den Weltenverderber zu bekämpfen.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#062.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#063.src: ...although, the stories differ. Some say that Bak'al was the first to enter the portal, and the Corrupter of Worlds was simply a beast from the Nether. But the unclear truth doesn't change his strength.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#063.dst: ...doch die Geschichten gehen auseinander. Manche sagen, Bak'al betrat das Portal zuerst und der Weltenverderber war nur eine Bestie aus dem Nether. Aber die unklare Wahrheit ändert nichts an seiner Stärke.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#063.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#064.src: Just remember that no one, aside from that snooty Kelight, will think less of you should you choose not to fight him.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#064.dst: Denk einfach daran: Niemand außer dem hochnäsigen Kelight wird schlechter von dir denken, wenn du nicht gegen ihn kämpfst.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#064.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#065.src: Show the [Purified Light Dust] to Kelight at the entrance of the Temple of the Legends at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#065.dst: Zeig Kelight am Eingang des Tempels der Legenden bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] den [Purified Light Dust].

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#066.src: You'll need an item to focus the magic around yourself, preferably something you'd wear. Hm... How about a helmet? Certainly, it'd do wonders for your poor sense of style.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#066.dst: Du brauchst einen Gegenstand, der die Magie um dich bündelt, am besten etwas zum Tragen. Hm... Wie wär's mit einem Helm? Der täte deinem dürftigen Stilempfinden sicher gut.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#066.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#067.src: Ahem. As for creating it... I know only one man capable of crafting a piece of armor good enough to ensure your safety.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#067.dst: Ähem. Was die Herstellung angeht... Ich kenne nur einen Mann, der eine Rüstung fertigen kann, die gut genug ist, dich zu schützen.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#067.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#068.src: Unfortunately, he will be hard to reach. His name was Garull, and he was the finest craftsman I'd ever met! A bit on the eccentric side, though.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#068.dst: Leider ist er schwer zu erreichen. Er hieß Garull und war der beste Handwerker, den ich je traf! Allerdings etwas exzentrisch.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#068.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#069.src: He was always ranting and raving about Creepers... he really thought they were real, can you imagine? What complete and utter nonsense.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#069.dst: Er schwafelte ständig von Creepern... er hielt sie wirklich für echt, stell dir vor! Was für ein kompletter Unsinn.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#069.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#070.src: In any case, it is somewhere to begin your search! Should you manage to find him, and convince him to craft you the helmet, return here and we can proceed.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#070.dst: Jedenfalls ist das ein Anfang für deine Suche! Findest du ihn und überzeugst ihn, dir den Helm zu fertigen, komm zurück, dann geht es weiter.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#070.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#071.src: Find Garull, the Creeper obsessed craftsman, somewhere in the {p} located around [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#071.dst: Finde Garull, den creeperbesessenen Handwerker, irgendwo in {p} um [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#072.src: GWUH! Oh god, don't scare me like that! Who... Who even are you?!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#072.dst: GWUH! Oh Gott, erschreck mich nicht so! Wer... Wer bist du überhaupt?!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#072.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#073.src: Ah, you were sent from Kelight for a protection helmet? I can do that, sure, but there's a few complications.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#073.dst: Ah, Kelight schickt dich wegen eines Schutzhelms? Kann ich machen, klar, aber es gibt ein paar Haken.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#073.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#074.src: See, I usually use something called Touroto Hide to make my armor. It's extremely resilient, magic resistant and tough to break.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#074.dst: Weißt du, für meine Rüstungen nehme ich meist Touroto Hide. Es ist extrem widerstandsfähig, magieresistent und kaum kaputtzukriegen.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#074.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#075.src: But, this also makes the Touroto themselves almost impossible to kill. Getting Touroto Hide is extremely difficult. I do know of a black market for it in {p}, but...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#075.dst: Aber deshalb sind die Touroto selbst auch fast unmöglich zu töten. An Touroto Hide zu kommen, ist extrem schwer. Ich kenne einen Schwarzmarkt in {p}, aber...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#075.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#076.src: They only sell useless Old Touroto Hide, gotten from ones that died of old age. It's almost no better than just plain leather.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#076.dst: Dort gibt es nur nutzloses Old Touroto Hide von Tieren, die an Altersschwäche starben. Kaum besser als normales Leder.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#076.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#077.src: So, for me to craft you this helmet, I'll need you to bring me not just the [Old Touroto Hide], but also the means to restore it to its previous power. Do listen up, there's a lot to tell you!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#077.dst: Damit ich dir den Helm fertige, bring mir also nicht nur das [Old Touroto Hide], sondern auch das Nötige, um ihm seine alte Kraft zurückzugeben. Hör gut zu, da kommt einiges!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#077.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#078.src: There's the [Aseado Leaf], grown someplace in the {p}... it has powerful medicinal qualities, supposedly able to reverse aging.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#078.dst: Da wäre das [Aseado Leaf], das irgendwo in {p} wächst... es hat starke Heilkräfte und soll das Altern umkehren.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#078.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#079.src: There's the [Aseado Leaf], grown someplace in the {p}...it has powerful medicinal qualities, supposedly able to reverse aging.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#079.dst: Da wäre das [Aseado Leaf], das irgendwo in {p} wächst...es hat starke Heilkräfte und soll das Altern umkehren.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#079.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#080.src: Then, a [Maro's Eye Jewel], which is an amazing magical focus from...well, where else, the {p}. Using its dust, I'll be able to return its magical resilience manually.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#080.dst: Dann ein [Maro's Eye Jewel], ein erstaunlicher magischer Fokus aus...na, woher wohl, aus {p}. Mit seinem Staub kann ich die Magieresistenz von Hand wiederherstellen.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#080.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#081.src: Finally, I'll need a [Coral of Nelfors], which can be found in the {p}. This is what I need to use to enchant the hide to be magically resistant.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#081.dst: Zuletzt brauche ich eine [Coral of Nelfors], die man in {p} findet. Damit verzaubere ich die Haut, damit sie Magie widersteht.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#081.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#082.src: I wrote all that down in your content book. If you can get it all, come back to see me, but don't be so sneaky about coming up to me please!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#082.dst: Ich hab dir alles ins Inhaltsbuch geschrieben. Hast du alles, komm wieder, aber schleich dich bitte nicht so an mich ran!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#082.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#083.src: Bring the [Old Touroto Hide], [Aseado Leaf], [Maro's Eye Jewel], and [Coral of Nelfors] to Garull in the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#083.dst: Bring [Old Touroto Hide], [Aseado Leaf], [Maro's Eye Jewel] und [Coral of Nelfors] zu Garull in der Höhle bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#084.src: Thank you for listening to me about not being so quiet coming over here. I'm guessing you've got everything?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#084.dst: Danke, dass du diesmal nicht so leise herkamst. Ich nehme an, du hast alles?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#084.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#085.src: Alright, this should go quickly. For however pompous Kelight is, he's right in sending you to me to craft this.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#085.dst: Gut, das geht schnell. So aufgeblasen Kelight auch ist, er hatte recht, dich dafür zu mir zu schicken.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#085.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#086.src: Now, I want to warn you about something. I've heard stories about the enemy you need this helmet to face, none of them good.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#086.dst: Ich will dich vor etwas warnen. Ich habe Geschichten über den Feind gehört, für den du den Helm brauchst, keine davon gut.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#086.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#087.src: While I have seen people return from killing the "beast" he talks about, it isn't often. Be very careful, should you choose to fight it.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#087.dst: Ich habe zwar Leute gesehen, die die "Bestie" erlegt haben, von der er spricht, aber selten. Sei sehr vorsichtig, falls du kämpfst.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#087.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#088.src: Bring the [Helmet of the Legends] to Kelight at the entrance of the Temple of the Legends at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#088.dst: Bring den [Helmet of the Legends] zu Kelight am Eingang des Tempels der Legenden bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#089.src: You have the helmet, I presume? Hand it over, here. I'll quickly apply the light dust. Then, you'll be able to enter the cave.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#089.dst: Du hast den Helm, nehme ich an? Gib her. Ich trage schnell das Light Dust auf. Dann kannst du die Höhle betreten.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#089.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#090.src: ...Well, good luck! I'm certain you'll either succeed, or you'll fail spectacularly. Either or, really.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#090.dst: ...Nun, viel Glück! Ich bin sicher, du wirst entweder siegen oder spektakulär scheitern. Eins von beiden, wirklich.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#090.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#091.src: Bring me concrete proof of your triumph over the beast, and I will grant you passage into the Temple of the Legends! Do be quick, would you?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#091.dst: Bring mir einen handfesten Beweis deines Siegs über die Bestie, und ich gewähre dir Zutritt zum Tempel der Legenden! Beeil dich, ja?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#091.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#092.src: Kill the Corrupter of Worlds in the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring proof of its death to Kelight at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#092.dst: Töte den Weltenverderber in der Höhle bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] und bring Kelight bei [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] einen Beweis seines Todes.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#093.dst: ... Du... Du hast es geschafft? W-wie?!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#093.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#094.src: Even one so brave and powerful as myself could not possibly survive against-
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#094.dst: Selbst jemand so Tapferes und Mächtiges wie ich könnte unmöglich überleben gegen-
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#094.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#095.src: Er... I mean, of course you were able to defeat the beast! I believed in you from the very start!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#095.dst: Äh... Ich meine, natürlich konntest du die Bestie besiegen! Ich habe von Anfang an an dich geglaubt!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#095.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#096.src: ...Ehm. I suppose you are welcome in the Temple of the Legends, now! You have... certainly proven yourself. My apologies for misjudging you. Feel proud of your accomplishment!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#096.dst: ...Ähm. Nun bist du wohl im Tempel der Legenden willkommen! Du hast dich... zweifellos bewiesen. Verzeih, dass ich dich falsch einschätzte. Sei stolz auf deine Leistung!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#096.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#097.src: Hm? What are these oddities you have with you? Curious, yet useless. Allow me to dispose of them for you.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#097.dst: Hm? Was sind das für Kuriositäten bei dir? Merkwürdig, aber nutzlos. Erlaube, dass ich sie für dich entsorge.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#097.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#098.src: Comprehensive Guide to Raising an Animal

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#099.src: This guide shall serve as your one-stop shop to caring for mounts.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#099.dst: Dieser Leitfaden ist deine Anlaufstelle für die Pflege von Reittieren.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#101.src: To ensure that a mount has the room and ability to grow and become strong, certain conditions have to be met.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#101.dst: Damit ein Reittier Platz und Möglichkeit hat, zu wachsen und stark zu werden, müssen bestimmte Bedingungen erfüllt sein.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#102.src: To start, a mount has to be placed inside a Feeder to be used. Feeders can be found in Enclosures.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#102.dst: Zunächst muss ein Reittier in einen Futtertrog gesetzt werden. Futtertröge stehen in Gehegen.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#103.src: For starters, a mount will get tired as you train it. They are living beings after all! Ensure they have enough food in their Feeder so they can regain their energy.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#103.dst: Erstens wird ein Reittier beim Training müde. Es sind schließlich Lebewesen! Sorge für genug Futter im Futtertrog, damit es Energie zurückgewinnt.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#104.src: Mounts love to eat or chew on almost any crafting material harvested from crop fields, from fish, even from trees and stones! Just make sure the material's level matches that of the mount for greatest effectiveness.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#104.dst: Reittiere fressen oder kauen fast jedes Herstellungsmaterial von Feldern, Fischen, sogar Bäumen und Steinen! Achte nur darauf, dass die Stufe des Materials zu der des Reittiers passt, für die beste Wirkung.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#105.src: You can purchase tools from Tool Merchants all over the provinces to harvest these materials yourself, too! Bring Grains, String, Paper, Planks, Ingots, Gems, Meat, or Oil to the Feeder to have a happy, well-fed mount.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#105.dst: Du kannst auch bei Werkzeughändlern in allen Provinzen Werkzeuge kaufen und die Materialien selbst sammeln! Bring Getreide, Fäden, Papier, Bretter, Barren, Edelsteine, Fleisch oder Öl zum Futtertrog für ein glückliches, satt gefressenes Reittier.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#106.src: Certain materials will boost different stats. For example, meat will boost Energy and Acceleration. They need a varied diet, just like us.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#106.dst: Bestimmte Materialien steigern verschiedene Werte. Fleisch etwa steigert Energie und Beschleunigung. Sie brauchen abwechslungsreiche Kost, genau wie wir.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#107.src: Breeding is useful for creating a strong and fast mount, capable of the most grueling journeys.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#107.dst: Zucht hilft, ein starkes, schnelles Reittier zu bekommen, das selbst die härtesten Reisen meistert.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#108.src: To breed a mount, simply put two of the same mount in the same row of a Feeder. Give it some time and you will see an offspring. A mount is only capable of breeding once they reach an average Limit of {~}.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#108.dst: Um ein Reittier zu züchten, setz einfach zwei gleiche Reittiere in dieselbe Reihe eines Futtertrogs. Gib ihnen etwas Zeit, dann siehst du Nachwuchs. Ein Reittier kann erst züchten, wenn es ein durchschnittliches Limit von {~} erreicht.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#109.src: The offspring will inherit some of the parents' visual traits, and will have a chance to gain better stats. If the mounts bred had any previous training done, the offspring will inherit that as well.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#109.dst: Der Nachwuchs erbt einige äußere Merkmale der Eltern und hat die Chance auf bessere Werte. Wurden die Eltern schon trainiert, erbt der Nachwuchs auch das.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#110.src: A mount's level can be increased to the Limit by training it. However, it can be further increased to its Max by feeding it.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#110.dst: Die Stufe eines Reittiers lässt sich durch Training bis zum Limit steigern. Durch Füttern lässt sie sich weiter bis zum Maximum erhöhen.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#111.src: Ensure your mounts have good food to eat if you want them to become strong! Refer to the General Information chapter for more information on feeding.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#111.dst: Gib deinen Reittieren gutes Futter, wenn sie stark werden sollen! Mehr zur Fütterung im Kapitel Allgemeine Informationen.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#112.src: Although most traits are self-explanatory, this guide has them sorted in a list for your convenience.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#112.dst: Die meisten Merkmale erklären sich zwar von selbst, doch dieser Leitfaden listet sie dir übersichtlich auf.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#113.src: Speed is all about the max speed your mount can reach.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#113.dst: Geschwindigkeit ist das Höchsttempo, das dein Reittier erreichen kann.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#114.src: Acceleration will ensure your mount reaches its max speed faster.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#114.dst: Beschleunigung lässt dein Reittier schneller sein Höchsttempo erreichen.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#115.src: Jump Height is all about... you guessed it - how high your mount can jump!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#115.dst: Sprunghöhe ist... du ahnst es schon - wie hoch dein Reittier springen kann!

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#116.src: Increasing the Energy stat increases the max energy your mount will have. A worthwhile investment if you're planning to travel across the provinces.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#116.dst: Ein höherer Energiewert erhöht die maximale Energie deines Reittiers. Eine lohnende Investition, wenn du durch die Provinzen reisen willst.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#117.src: Handling is all about your mount's movement efficiency.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#117.dst: Wendigkeit betrifft die Bewegungseffizienz deines Reittiers.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#118.src: Increasing the stat will allow your mount to more easily climb steep surfaces, turn faster, and be slightly more nimble before they reach their top speeds.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#118.dst: Ein höherer Wert lässt dein Reittier steile Hänge leichter erklimmen, schneller wenden und etwas flinker sein, bevor es Höchsttempo erreicht.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#119.src: Toughness helps prevent your mount from becoming startled and throwing you off, in case you're ambushed by an enemy.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#119.dst: Robustheit verhindert, dass dein Reittier scheut und dich abwirft, falls dich ein Gegner überfällt.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#120.src: Boost will ensure that your mounts make the most out of the boosts they find in the wild.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#120.dst: Schub sorgt dafür, dass deine Reittiere das Beste aus den Schubfeldern in der Wildnis herausholen.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#121.src: A good Training trait will allow your mount to more easily become stronger and improve as you train it.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#121.dst: Ein guter Trainingswert lässt dein Reittier leichter stärker werden und sich beim Training verbessern.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#122.src: Rumor has it this creature was one of the miners which first ventured into the Portal... Of course, as a Legend, I would usually disregard such things. Such a premise is hard to believe.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#122.dst: Gerüchten zufolge war dieses Wesen einer der Bergleute, die als Erste ins Portal vordrangen... Als Legende gebe ich natürlich nichts auf so etwas. Die Behauptung ist kaum zu glauben.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#122.speaker: Kelight

similar.text: Rumor has it this creature was one of the miners which first ventured into the Nether Portal... Of course, as a Legend, I would usually disregard such things.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#123.src: In any case, its power cannot be understated. Simply entering its cave will greatly weaken you, even with the best equipment!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#123.dst: Jedenfalls ist seine Macht nicht zu unterschätzen. Schon das Betreten seiner Höhle schwächt dich stark, selbst mit bester Ausrüstung!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#123.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#124.src: Getting close to it would quickly corrupt you, which is why you will need protection. Only a light whose origin is from the same realm from which the beast arrived will do the trick.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#124.dst: Näher an ihn heranzukommen, würde dich rasch verderben, darum brauchst du Schutz. Nur ein Licht aus demselben Reich, aus dem die Bestie kam, wird helfen.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#124.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#125.src: As such, your very first step on your journey to become a Legend will be... to visit a friend of mine who studies the Portal and that which lies... beyond.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#125.dst: Daher ist dein allererster Schritt auf dem Weg zur Legende... einen Freund von mir zu besuchen, der das Portal erforscht und das, was... dahinter liegt.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#125.speaker: Kelight

similar.text: As such, your very first step on your journey to become a Legend will be... to visit a friend of mine who studies the Nether.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#126.src: Well? You've been given a task, haven't you? Don't come back until you've retrieved the light you'll need for protection.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#126.dst: Nun? Du hast eine Aufgabe, oder? Komm erst wieder, wenn du das Licht für deinen Schutz geholt hast.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#127.src: ...I see. Yes, the corruption of the blasted Portal is rather potent. I'm not surprised this would need purification.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#127.dst: ...Verstehe. Ja, die Verderbnis des verfluchten Portals ist ziemlich stark. Kein Wunder, dass das gereinigt werden muss.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#127.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#128.src: Yes, yes. I imagine that Kelight didn't bother telling you that was its title. I also surmise that you were given few details of how it came to be...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#128.dst: Ja, ja. Kelight hat sich wohl nicht die Mühe gemacht, dir seinen Titel zu nennen. Und vermutlich erfuhrst du kaum, wie er entstand...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#128.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#129.src: The beast now known as the Corrupter of Worlds is said to have been a simple mining captain, during the expeditions that uncovered the Nether Portal. It is told he was the first to enter that wicked realm.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#129.dst: Die Bestie, heute bekannt als der Weltenverderber, soll ein einfacher Bergbauhauptmann gewesen sein, bei den Expeditionen, die das Netherportal freilegten. Er soll als Erster jenes üble Reich betreten haben.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#129.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#130.src: The man was never heard from again...well, that is until the corrupted hordes began to pour from the Realm of War, with him leading the pack. A bit ironic, isn't it? Led the miners in life, the corrupteds in death.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#130.dst: Man hörte nie wieder von dem Mann...bis die verderbten Horden aus dem Reich des Krieges strömten, mit ihm an der Spitze. Etwas ironisch, oder? Im Leben führte er die Bergleute, im Tod die Verderbten.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#130.speaker: Rayshyroth

similar.text: The poor man was never heard from again...well, that is until the corrupted hordes began to pour from the Nether, with him leading the pack. A bit ironic, isn't it? Led the miners in life, the corrupteds in death.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#131.src: The mining crew there lasted hardly minutes. He personally slaughtered every single one of his original crew, and thousands more. The energies of the Nether have made him monstrously powerful.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#131.dst: Die Bergbautruppe dort hielt kaum Minuten durch. Er schlachtete eigenhändig jeden seiner einstigen Leute ab, und Tausende mehr. Die Energien des Nethers haben ihn ungeheuer mächtig gemacht.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#131.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#132.src: Hah. Took you long enough! This is the light dust, I presume?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#132.dst: Hah. Hat ja gedauert! Das ist das Light Dust, nehme ich an?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#132.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#133.src: I'll hold on to this for now. While it is a vital ingredient for your protection, it is not enough on its own.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#133.dst: Das behalte ich vorerst. Es ist zwar eine wichtige Zutat für deinen Schutz, reicht aber allein nicht.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#133.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#134.src: When I suggested the notion to be absurd, he seemed upset by my comments, and stopped visiting. Truly, I don't know what I did wrong. What a ridiculous man.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#134.dst: Als ich die Idee absurd nannte, schien er gekränkt und kam nicht mehr vorbei. Ich weiß wirklich nicht, was ich falsch gemacht habe. Was für ein lächerlicher Mann.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#134.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#135.src: As it stands, I have no idea where you could find him. He spoke of wanting to research the Pigman Ravines several times, though none of our rank have ever seen him there.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#135.dst: Derzeit habe ich keine Ahnung, wo du ihn findest. Er sprach mehrmals davon, die Schweinemenschen-Schluchten zu erforschen, doch keiner von uns hat ihn je dort gesehen.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#135.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#136.src: Well? You've been given a task, haven't you? Don't come back until you've found Garull and obtained a helmet.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#136.dst: Nun? Du hast eine Aufgabe, oder? Komm erst wieder, wenn du Garull gefunden und einen Helm hast.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#137.src: ...Hm? Oh, it's you again. Did you manage to actually find the blighter? Good to know he isn't dead, at least.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#137.dst: ...Hm? Ach, du schon wieder. Hast du den Kerl wirklich gefunden? Gut zu wissen, dass er wenigstens nicht tot ist.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#137.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#138.src: Hopefully you'll do better than that last group that tried to fight it. Six fighters strong... never came back.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#138.dst: Hoffentlich schlägst du dich besser als die letzte Gruppe, die es versuchte. Sechs Kämpfer... nie zurückgekehrt.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#138.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#139.src: ...You're still here? You have your challenge. Slay that beast within the cave, and bring me proof. Then, and only then, will you have proven your worth.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#139.dst: ...Du bist noch hier? Du hast deine Aufgabe. Erschlag die Bestie in der Höhle und bring mir einen Beweis. Dann, und nur dann, hast du dich bewiesen.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#140.src: I am proud to have you in our temple! Perhaps one day you shall be almost as great as I am!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#140.dst: Ich bin stolz, dich in unserem Tempel zu haben! Vielleicht wirst du eines Tages fast so groß wie ich!

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#141.src: However, as a Legend, I am very busy, autographs and the sort, and that's not to mention my guard duty! Let me see if you are even worth my time.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#141.dst: Doch als Legende bin ich sehr beschäftigt, Autogramme und dergleichen, ganz zu schweigen vom Wachdienst! Mal sehen, ob du meine Zeit überhaupt wert bist.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#141.speaker: Legend Guard

similar.text: However, as a Legend, I am very busy, autographs and the sort, and that's not to mention my guard duty! To prove you are even worth my time, return when you reach Level {~}.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#142.src: Yko dare kker these sk:;DJkkkAJEkkkkThkksad:ek ghakkkkkreid:

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#143.src: You still have the chance to give up. You can stop trying to fight that thing at any time...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#143.dst: Du kannst immer noch aufgeben. Du kannst jederzeit aufhören, gegen dieses Ding kämpfen zu wollen...

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#144.src: Remember, check your content book for guidance.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#144.dst: Denk dran, im Inhaltsbuch findest du Hilfe.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#145.src: This is the Light Dust that Jorkin mentioned! He said to bring it back to him...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#145.dst: Das ist das Light Dust, von dem Jorkin sprach! Er sagte, ich soll es ihm zurückbringen...

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#146.src: Give [{~} Sky Vapor] and the Light Dust to Rayshyroth at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#146.dst: Gib [{~} Sky Vapor] und das Light Dust an Rayshyroth bei [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#147.src: Find Garull, the Creeper obsessed craftsman, somewhere in the Pigmen's Ravines located around [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#147.dst: Finde Garull, den creeperbesessenen Handwerker, irgendwo in Pigmen's Ravines um [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
